title: Notice: Annual Examination Schedule
summary: Bilingual (Hindi and English) notice MPS/ADM/2024/112 from Model Public School, Jaipur, dated 02/01/2024, announcing that annual examinations begin on 15/03/2024. The examination fee must be deposited by 20/02/2024 and admit cards are available from 05/03/2024. Signed by the Principal, Dr. S. Iyer.

ocrText.text:
आदर्श पब्लिक स्कूल / Model Public School
12 Demo Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001
सूचना / NOTICE
Ref No: MPS/ADM/2024/112 दिनांक / Date: 02/01/2024
विषय: वार्षिक परीक्षा कार्यक्रम / Subject: Annual Examination Schedule
सभी छात्रों एवं अभिभावकों को सूचित किया जाता है कि वार्षिक परीक्षा 15/03/2024 से प्रारंभ होगी। परीक्षा शुल्क जमा करने की अंतिम तिथि 20/02/2024 है। प्रवेश पत्र 05/03/2024 से कार्यालय से प्राप्त किए जा सकते हैं।
All students and parents are informed that the annual examinations will begin on 15/03/2024. The last date for depositing the examination fee is 20/02/2024. Admit cards can be collected from the office from 05/03/2024.
प्रधानाचार्य / Principal
Dr. S. Iyer
Model Public School
To: All students of Classes IX to XII and their parents
